camel_example:
aliyun cloudauth-intl DocOcrV2 --region cn-hangzhou --IdOcrPictureBase64 'base64
' --MerchantUserId 123456789 --IdOcrPictureUrl 'https://digital-cardocr-prod8.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/1669520556530-expo/default/face/20221127114236530_w3kx2e6t.jpg' --IdFaceQuality F --ProductCode '产品方案类型ID_OCR_MIN
' --MerchantBizId 'dso9322***dsjsd22
' --IdOcrPictureFile InputStream --IdThreshold '0
' --CardSide 'OCR_ID_FACE
' --DocType '00000006
' --Ocr 'T

description_en: Performs server-side optical character recognition (OCR) on ID cards
kebab_example:
aliyun cloudauth-intl doc-ocr-v2 --merchant-biz-id 'dso9322***dsjsd22
' --merchant-user-id 123456789 --id-ocr-picture-base64 'base64
' --id-ocr-picture-url https://digital-cardocr-prod8.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/1669520556530-expo/default/face/20221127114236530_w3kx2e6t.jpg --id-ocr-picture-file InputStream --doc-type '00000006
' --product-code '产品方案类型ID_OCR_MIN
' --ocr 'T
' --id-face-quality F --spoof F --id-threshold '0
' --card-side 'OCR_ID_FACE
' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DocOcrV2

parameters.help_en: The custom unique business identifier on the merchant side, which is used for subsequent troubleshooting. It supports a combination of letters and digits, with a maximum length of 32 characters. Make sure that the identifier is unique
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长 32 位，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The custom user ID in the business. Make sure that the ID is unique
parameters.help_zh: 业务中自定义的用户 ID，请保持唯一
parameters.name: merchant_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded image of the ID card.

If you choose to pass the ID card photo by using the Base64-encoded image (IdOcrPictureBase64), check the photo size and do not pass oversized photos
parameters.help_zh:
卡证图片 Base64 编码。

如果您选择 IdOcrPictureBase64（照片 Base64 编码）方式传入证件照片，请注意检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片
parameters.name: id_ocr_picture_base64

parameters.help_en: The URL of the front image of the ID card
parameters.name: id_ocr_picture_url

parameters.help_en: The file stream of the front image of the ID card
parameters.help_zh: 证件正面图片 文件流
parameters.name: id_ocr_picture_file

parameters.help_en: The type of the ID card
parameters.name: doc_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform OCR on the ID card. Valid values:
T: OCR is performed on the ID card.
F: OCR is not performed on the ID card
parameters.help_zh:
是否进行证件 OCR

T：表示需要证件 OCR
F：表示不需要
parameters.name: ocr

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform face quality check for the ID card. Valid values:
T: Face quality check is performed.
F: Face quality check is not performed. Default value: F
parameters.help_zh:
是否进行证脸质量检测

T：表示需要检测
F：表示需要检测（默认 F）
parameters.name: id_face_quality

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable anti-spoofing check. Valid values:
T: Anti-spoofing check is enabled.
F: Anti-spoofing check is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启防伪检测

T：表示开启防伪
F：表示关闭
parameters.name: spoof

parameters.help_en:
The custom threshold mode for OCR quality check. Valid values:
0: system default.
1: strict mode.
2: loose mode.
3: disables quality check. Default value: 3
parameters.help_zh:
自定义 OCR 质量检测阈值模式：

0：系统默认
1：严格模式
2：宽松模式
3（默认）：关闭质量检测
parameters.name: id_threshold

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the side of the ID card, which can be the national emblem side or the portrait side. If you do not specify this parameter, the portrait side is used by default. Valid values:
OCR_ID_FACE: the portrait side. Default value.
OCR_ID_NATIONAL_EMBLEM: the national emblem side
parameters.help_zh:
区分证件国徽面和人像面 ，不传默认人像面 。

OCR_ID_FACE （默认）：人像面

OCR_ID_NATIONAL_EMBLEM ：国徽面
parameters.name: card_side

ExtIdInfo.description_en: The ID card recognition result. This parameter is returned only when the API response is successful
ExtIdInfo.description_zh: 卡证识别结果 只有当接口响应成功时返回

Passed.description_en:
Indicates whether the authentication is passed. Valid values:
Y: passed.
N: not passed
Passed.description_zh:
认证是否通过。

Y：通过
N：不通过

TransactionId.description_en: The unique identifier of the authentication request
